note: This metric is not age-standardized, so differences between countries partly reflect differences in their age structure.
title: Share of men aged 70 and older with schizophrenia
subtitle: Estimated share of men aged 70 and older who have [schizophrenia](#dod:schizophrenia), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing schizophrenia at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
